results.title: What is the best medicine
results.description: In the complex world of modern healthcare, the question “What is the best medicine?” does not have a single, universal answer. Instead, the “best” medicine is defined by Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM)—a rigorous approach that integrates clinical expertise, patient values, and the most current, high-quality research available.
